synthesis.firstDisappearance: localStorage (no hero reel / no heroAssetId at boot)
interpretation: Cold boot with empty hero keys → heroAssetId="" and vaultItemsCount=0 at resolveHeroBackgroundAsset (matches user log).
First emptiness is at localStorage boot — not a mid-pipeline drop of a previously selected asset in this profile.
When reelforge_hero_reel + matching heroAssetId + backgroundSource=custom_video are present, hydration preserves the asset (Pass B: vaultItemsCount=1, DOM plays seeded MP4).
loadHeroVaultItems() returns [] when manager.heroAssetId !== reel.id even if the reel exists (Pass C) — measurable gate that yields vaultItemsCount=0.
Default fallback /videos/hero-background.mp4 returns HTTP 404; /hero-background.mp4 returns 200. Cold boot attempts the 404 path repeatedly before carousel content appears.
RC2 "Hero persistence OK" and runtime vaultItemsCount=0 are compatible: different localStorage profiles. Persistence works when keys are written; empty profile resolves empty.

verdictDetail: Primary: empty localStorage at boot → empty resolver. Secondary concrete failure: default fallback /videos/hero-background.mp4 is 404. Proven gate: id mismatch empties vault. Proven positive: matched seed hydrates.
